acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every test block that sets process.stdout.isTTY restores the original value in afterEach or try/finally
Running the affected test files in isolation and as part of the full suite produces the same results

summary: Identified 3 test files with isTTY mutations: screen.test.ts, create-menu.test.ts, and setup/runner.test.ts.
setup/runner.test.ts already used correct try/finally save-restore — no changes needed.

screen.test.ts: added beforeEach (save) + afterEach (restore + restoreAllMocks) to both clearScreen() and waitForKey() describe blocks, replacing the restore-only afterEach pattern. Added beforeEach import to the vitest import line.

create-menu.test.ts: added beforeEach/afterEach save-restore to the 'run([]) — interactive menu' describe block (3 tests), and wrapped the standalone 'never calls process.exit()' test with try/finally.

comments.note: tests/setup/runner.test.ts already used the try/finally save-restore pattern correctly — no changes needed there. The inconsistency was isolated to screen.test.ts and create-menu.test.ts.

tests/screen.test.ts had afterEach(vi.restoreAllMocks) in both describe blocks but relied on it to handle isTTY mutations — Object.defineProperty mutations are invisible to vi.restoreAllMocks(), so the guards were silently ineffective. Added explicit beforeEach/afterEach save-restore to both describe blocks.

summary: Audited all 4 isTTY mutation sites across 2 files: all use beforeEach/afterEach or try/finally save-restore.
screen.test.ts clearScreen() block: process.stdout.isTTY saved in beforeEach, restored in afterEach (with vi.restoreAllMocks). Correct.
screen.test.ts waitForKey() block: process.stdin.isTTY saved in beforeEach, restored in afterEach (with vi.restoreAllMocks). Correct.
create-menu.test.ts 'run([]) — interactive menu' describe: process.stdin.isTTY saved in beforeEach, restored in afterEach. Correct.
create-menu.test.ts 'never calls process.exit()' standalone test: local save + try/finally restore. Correct.
Isolation run (vitest run tests/screen.test.ts tests/create-menu.test.ts): 7+25=32 tests pass — same counts as in full suite.
Full suite: 229/229 tests pass. No regressions.

comments.note: No defects. The save-restore pattern is consistently applied across all four mutation sites: stdout.isTTY in screen.test.ts clearScreen() block, stdin.isTTY in screen.test.ts waitForKey() block, stdin.isTTY in create-menu.test.ts interactive-menu describe, and stdin.isTTY in the standalone process.exit() test. Nested beforeEach/afterEach pairs do not interfere with the parent suite's spy-restoration afterEach.

summary: Code review passed. isTTY save-restore pattern is correctly implemented across all four mutation sites. beforeEach/afterEach used for describe-scoped mutations; try/finally for the standalone test. No blocking issues. One documentation-forward: add a test conventions note about Object.defineProperty mutations not being covered by vi.restoreAllMocks().

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. The correct tool is selected for each context: beforeEach/afterEach for describe-scoped mutations, try/finally for the standalone test. The asymmetry between screen.test.ts (two peer-level describes, each managing their own vi.restoreAllMocks()) and the nested create-menu describe (relying on parent afterEach for spy restoration) is intentional and correct.

[documentation-forward] The constraints.md or a test conventions file could note the Object.defineProperty save-restore requirement for isTTY mutations (and that vi.restoreAllMocks() does NOT cover Object.defineProperty mutations). This is a subtle gotcha that the Developer comment already identified — worth capturing as a standing convention so future contributors don't re-introduce the silent-failure pattern.
